exact_statement: For every fixed real K>0, let R_K(f) be the full physical stopping hull with payoff (H(f)-K I(f))_+, and let T_K(f) be the least initially supplied credit solvent at every future admission/query/stop arrival when initial admitted set is empty, admissions preserve actual credit, and every physical query uses the CURRENT admitted-set hull allocation a_b=a+rho_M(child_b)-mean rho_M(children). There is a finite dimension-independent L>=0 with T_K(f)<=L R_K(f) for all uniform Boolean f if and only if H(f)<=K I(f) for all uniform Boolean f. Explicitly, any finite seed f on n bits with A_K=H(f)-K I(f)>0 gives actual Boolean G_d(s,x,z)=chi_r(z)*[f(x) if s=0^d else+1], with r an integer satisfying K r>=n+3, for which T_K(G_d)>=A_K while 0<R_K(G_d)<=4*2^(-d)*(n+2d+2) for every integer d>=3. In particular, use the24-bit f=J(-1,+1,g,g,g,g), g negative on{0,1,2}, h negative on{0,1,2,4,8,16,32,6,17,40}, J(x)=-h(x xor1), bit1 meaning sign-1, all four g blocks disjoint. With r=7, uniformly for EVERY real K in the closed interval[4,33/8], T_K(G_d)>1/256 and 0<R_K(G_d)<=4*2^(-d)*(26+2d) for d>=3. At d=20 this is an actual51-bit accounting witness. The auxiliary activation entropy profile is analytically bounded on all real delta in[0,1/4], with zero limit at delta=0; actual physical guards have delta=2^(-d). The rare positive-arrival capital bound does not extend to the zero-reach face, where the function is parity and both capitals are0. This does not disprove FEI: H(G_d)/I(G_d) tends0.
hypotheses: Uniform finite cubes, mutually disjoint seed/selector/parity coordinates, Boolean +/-1 truth tables, entropy in bits and total physical influence.
The prescribed allocator uses the exact CURRENT admitted-set stopping hull. Stop, singleton admissions and all physical queries are allowed; no fresh credit is added on admissions.
Solvency is required at every positive-reach arrival, keeping actual inherited credit. Credit owners are nonnegative and old debit labels may be signed with nonnegative total.
The generic equivalence assumes K>0; the explicit constant lower bound assumes K in[4,33/8]. K=0 and zero-reach branches are not silently included.
All credits discussed are already supplied/booked; the theorem does not produce an unused influence-funded donor or change old terminal bills.
